literal_meaning: এক মুঠো বা ছোট পরিমাণ পাওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: to find a limit or boundary
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজের কোনো থই পাচ্ছি না, অসীম মনে হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I'm not finding any limit to this work; it feels endless.
I finally reached my limit of patience this time.
note: The idiom draws from the concept of 'থই' as a small handful, symbolizing a finite measure in an otherwise boundless situation.
